item.title: Ultrafast light switch for optical data components
item.description: Researchers move a step closer to femtosecond switching of ‘light by light’ for photonic computing based on polaritons.

item.title: Nonlinear metasurfaces convert infrared light to visible
item.description: A new nonlinear metasurface retains nonlocal, high-Q enhancement while preserving subwavelength per-pixel phase control—and it’s a big step toward on-chip visible/ultraviolet light sources, LiDAR beam steering, quantum light generation, optical signal processing, and polarization-encoded computing.

item.title: ‘Optics when you must’ arrives for data centers
item.description: Dense wavelength-division multiplexing copackaged optics technology offers architectural advantages in cost, power, and performance that will compound as AI infrastructure scales.

item.title: PODCAST: Interview with Barry Silverstein, University of Rochester Center for eXtended Reality
item.description: Episode 88 of Following the Photons: A Photonics Podcast features Barry Silverstein, director of the University of Rochester Center for eXtended Reality.

item.title: Copper welds via green laser create superfast data center connections
item.description: As global demand for data centers soars, so do the stakes for flawless data transmission. Green wavelength lasers paired with AI-driven process check and inspection ensure precision welding of critical copper connections to provide the speed, accuracy, and repeatable quality required by modern information highways.

item.title: Fabrication of silicon photonics with integrated III–V materials at scale
item.description: The growing demand for high-bandwidth, energy-efficient optical transceivers has accelerated interest in heterogeneous integration of III–V semiconductors on silicon—pairing high-performance light sources with the scalability of silicon photonics.

item.title: Dual-sided laser processing can tap static beam shaping and splitting
item.description: Three-dimensional (3D) beam shaping improves laser processing speed and enables new industrial laser applications.
